title: ItsGiving webcam meme overlay for meetings
summary: ItsGiving maps face expressions and hand/body poses to meme overlays and publishes the result as a virtual camera for meeting software; the repository documents 14 built-in reactions and a calibrated v2 detector.
research_notes:
Create a Python 3.11 or 3.12 virtual environment and install the pinned requirements.

Run `python its_giving_v2.py --calibrate`, remain neutral for the seven-second calibration, then run `python its_giving_v2.py`.

Install a virtual-camera backend for the operating system, start ItsGiving before the meeting application, then select the published virtual camera in that application's video settings.

Keep the dependency pins unchanged: the documented MediaPipe, NumPy and OpenCV compatibility constraints are coupled.

Use v2 and recalibrate when needed because its expression thresholds are based on the user's neutral-face baseline.

When adding a pose, check pose order before lowering thresholds, because the first matching pose wins; use the HUD and an arm count to tune false triggers.

Test reactions before using them in a meeting because the output can trigger automatically and is visible to all call participants.
